name: MicMic

llm.note: auto means: use it when GEMINI_API_KEY exists, otherwise fall back to the keyless path. Set to false to never use it. Only two jobs go here: splitting compound requests, and answering knowledge questions. The clock and the weather never do.

_activation_note: push = press the orb or the spacebar. wake = always listening, acts only after a wake word. always = acts on everything it hears.
_contacts_note: Contacts come from WhatsApp and fall back to the macOS Contacts app. Put a name in pinned_contacts only to force it to the top of the shortlist.
